title: Director of Ecommerce
description:
Based in San Francisco and handcrafted in Spain, Frēda Salvador is building community from the ground up. Footwear and accessories handmade in our family factories in Spain and EL Salvador.

We are a fast paced start up and are hustling everyday. We are driven. We are small, but mighty with strong values in teamwork and a positive and supportive work environment.

We are looking for a passionate, analytical, and creative Ecom & Digital leader. This role will drive the ecom business efforts across all digital channels. The ideal candidate is passionate about our customer data, understands fashion & luxury products, and knows how to drive the full funnel Ecommerce experience. This role owns all aspects of Ecommerce.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Director of Ecommerce & Retention will own and lead the Fredasalvador.com business. This leader is responsible for the full-funnel ecommerce experience, from guiding customer acquisition in partnership with performance marketing teams to owning the entire post-purchase lifecycle. You will own the ecommerce P&L, lead financial forecasting, and serve as the strategic engine for digital growth, scaling the brand through data-driven decisions and best-in-class customer experiences.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • P&L & Forecasting: Take full accountability for hitting monthly, quarterly, and annual ecommerce sales plans. Lead both top-down and bottom-up financial forecasting, identifying proactive opportunities and reactive pivots based on business trends. Partner with planning, merchandising and paid media teams.
  • Channel Leadership: Drive the ecommerce business efforts across all digital and direct mail channels.
  • Budget Oversight: Direct responsibility for managing the annual and monthly Ecommerce P&L, including management and authority for third-party technology.
  • Identify new opportunities for scale, and partner with leadership to execute.
  • Consistent awareness of competitive landscape and key action items
  • Lead data analytics reporting, and utilize insights to drive scale.
  • Identify evolving technology needs and execute new initiatives.
  • Drive scale sustainably, work towards scale within the company budget finding creative ways to maximize and optimize while testing new initiatives.
  • People/Team Management. Leading, coaching, upskilling and mentoring of direct reports.
  • Be customer obsessed, drive loyalty and retention.
  • Monitor and analyze customer lifecycle, create strategies to drive growth.
2. CRM, Lifecycle & Retention (Full Ownership)
  • Retention Strategy: Own the "Repeat Customer Rate" and "LTV" metrics. Develop and revamp comprehensive lifecycle marketing strategies to drive customer loyalty.
  • Email & SMS: Own and run end-to-end programs, from campaign planning and A/B testing to execution and performance analysis.
  • Loyalty & Referrals: Level up the Yotpo Loyalty program, making recommendations to improve engagement, reward redemption, and "Refer a Friend" initiatives.
  • CRM Analytics: Partner with agencies to build advanced customer segments for highly targeted email and on-site experiences.
  • Shopify Management: Oversee day-to-day site operations, including product launches, collection updates, and promotions.
  • User Experience: Coordinate plans for CRO and UX/UI testing to optimize engagement and conversion.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with Planning and Merchandising to ensure the digital channel has the right assortments and inventory to support the forecast.
  • Directly responsible for managing the budget and relationship with our external development team; working closely to not only maintain the site but work towards ongoing site optimization and enhancement.
4. Marketing & Paid Media Support
  • Performance Partnership: you will serve as the strategic partner to the growth team, digital agency and marketing team to support growth across all paid channels (PPC, SEO, Social, Affiliate, and Influencer Marketing) as these channels relate to driving the forecast.
  • Conversion Optimization: Provide conversion, product, and landing page recommendations to marketing and agency partners to ensure a seamless experience for traffic coming from performance media.
REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
  • Experience: 6+ years in digital brand strategy, e-commerce and digital marketing, with 2+ years of experience leading and managing a team.
  • Technical Proficiency: Expert knowledge of Shopify+, Google Analytics, and retention platforms like Attentive or Klaviyo.
  • Analytical Mindset: Proven ability to define and deliver performance metrics and glean actionable creative insights from data.
  • Background: Experience in the fashion or luxury space is preferred, with an entrepreneurial spirit comfortable in a fast-paced startup environment.
COMPANY BENEFITS AND COMPENSATION

This is a full time position. Alongside a unique and incredible culture, FREDA SALVADOR offers competitive salaries commensurate with experience and education and a benefits package that includes flexible vacation time, group medical, dental and vision plans, an employer-sponsored 401K retirement plan, flexible hybrid work schedule, and a generous discounts and shoe gratis program.

title: Engineer Manager
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. THE ROLE The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope. - Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth. - Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development. - Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions. - Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value. - Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation. - Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope. - Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts. WHAT IT TAKES - Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment. - Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.G., C#, Go, React, TypeScript, AWS). - Familiarity with agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, and software delivery processes. - Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders. - Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members. - Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices. - Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment. Be fully aligned to our core values: - Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. - Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. - Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. - Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. WHAT WE OFFER - Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style. - Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. - Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. - Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all. - Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. - An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued. Our Commitment to Inclusion At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

description:
Descrição da vaga Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online. Nos tornamos a marca que melhor representa a economia circular no país. Hoje contamos com dois escritórios nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho flexível oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negócio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa. Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade. Responsabilidades e atribuições Se você gosta de aprender e quer fazer parte desse desafio, essa oportunidade é a sua chance. Nessa posição de Data Science Specialist I, você vai somar ao time Data Science que tem como objetivo construir soluções de dados para evoluir experiência do usuário e métricas de negócio de forma escalável. No dia a dia você vai: Construir e manter pipelines completos de treinamento, versionamento, testes e deploy de modelos de ML Implementar práticas de MLOps para automação, monitoramento e manutenção de modelos em produção Gerenciar ambientes, contêineres, GPUs, escalabilidade e orquestração de recursos Atuar em parceria com Cientistas de IA para transformar experimentos em soluções produtivas Garantir observabilidade dos modelos, monitorando drift, performance, custo, logs e métricas Criar infraestrutura de experimentação e padronizar fluxos de desenvolvimento de IA Suportar segurança, governança e boas práticas na gestão do ciclo de vida dos modelos E o que você precisa ter? Experiência com pipelines de ML/MLOps, CI/CD (Github Actions) e ferramentas como Kubeflow, MLflow, Airflow, AWS Sagemaker Conhecimento em containers (Docker), Kubernetes, APIs e Python Vivência em ambientes Cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure) Forte entendimento de modelos de Machine Learning Diferenciais: Experiência com modelagem e manipulação de dados em larga escala Experiência com processamento e deploy de modelos em tempo real/NRT Mais sobre o Grupo OLX: No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis;
e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real. Benefícios: Remuneração compatível com o mercado;

title: Analista De Controladoria Sr (Comercial)
description:
Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades: Monitorar o processo (SOP) de vendas de resíduos e sucatas da Bracell Papéis, garantindo robustez e eficiência no processo. Realizar estudo de mercado quanto aos preços praticados dos itens comercializados. Garantir que o fluxo de comercialização segue o que foi descrito no SOP e que todos as aprovações e análises estão de acordo com as melhores práticas. Negociar e comercializar todos os produtos (Ativos, sucata, resíduos, peças não aproveitáveis e outros) da Bracell Papéis Nordeste. Realizar análises financeiras, bem como, identificar oportunidades durante a comercialização dos itens a serem vendidos. Participar e suportar as atividades relacionadas a ética e compliance na empresa. Elaborar e emitir relatórios gerenciais para tomada de decisões. Controlar as vendas, faturamentos, retirada e recebimentos. Requisitos: Curso superior completo em administração de empresas e/ou ciência contábeis ou áreas comerciais. Experiência mínima em comercialização de produtos. Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana-BA, para vaga temporária (licença maternidade);
Pacote Office avançado. Desejável conhecimento nos itens a serem comercializados. Desejável conhecer os aspectos e impactos ambientais de sua atividade. Diferencial: experiência com o sistema SAP. Aviso Legal: Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis. Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência. Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

title: Engenheiro(A) De Software Backend - Especialista
description:

Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis. Seria legal se você conhecesse: Conhecimento em desenvolvimento em C# ;

title: Language Specialist
description: Job Title: Language Specialist – AI Training (Freelancer) Location: Brazil (Remote – Candidates must be based in Brazil) About the Role: As a Language Specialist, you will play a vital role in training and enhancing Large Language Models (LLMs). This involves evaluating prompts, rating AI-generated outputs, and creating high-quality content to improve the accuracy, fluency, and cultural relevance of AI systems used by global technology leaders. Key Responsibilities: Evaluate AI-generated prompts and responses for linguistic accuracy, coherence, and contextual relevance. Provide structured ratings and feedback on AI outputs, highlighting errors, biases, or inconsistencies. Develop, edit, and curate high-quality content for training datasets across diverse domains. Collaborate with linguists, annotators, and AI researchers to refine model performance. Ensure cultural and linguistic nuances are accurately represented. Follow established guidelines while also suggesting improvements for evaluation frameworks. Qualifications: Strong written and spoken command of the target language, with excellent grammar and stylistic skills. Prior experience in content writing, editing, or evaluation preferred. Analytical mindset with keen attention to detail. Interest in AI, NLP, or LLMs will be an advantage.

Ex: Java (Spring Boot, Quarkus), .NET, Node.Js, Python, PHP, etc ● Proatividade para identificar gargalos e conduzir melhorias de impacto ● Perfil colaborativo e orientado a influenciar engenharia com profundidade técnica ● Capacidade de atuar sob pressão em ambientes de missão crítica (core de investimentos) ● Fome por evolução tecnológica, dados, automação e inovação contínua DIFERENCIAL: ● Conhecimento do mercado financeiro de investimentos. description: Na Agropalma, há muita coisa boa à sua espera. Então, se você é um profissional apaixonado por aprendizado e gosta de trabalhar em união, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Juntos, alcançaremos nosso objetivos. Estamos com oportunidades para pessoas com deficiência para todo o grupo. Instrução: Ensino Completo em Ciências contábeis, engenharias, ou áreas relacionadas a ciências exatas. Sobre a Agropalma A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. Atualmente, a companhia conta com seis indústrias de extração de óleo bruto, duas refinarias e um terminal de exportação alfandegado, e emprega cerca de 5 mil colaboradores. A Agropalma também foi pioneira em implementar, há mais de 20 anos, um programa de Agricultura Familiar com palma, que beneficia hoje mais de 300 agricultores parceiros. Guiada pelo compromisso com o planeta e as pessoas, a empresa segue avançando em suas práticas para tornar a palma sustentável uma referência brasileira. Para mais informações, acesse:.

title: Immigration Paralegal
description: Company Description Brooks Law Firm is a trusted legal practice dedicated to serving clients in immigration, personal injury, social security disability, and workers' compensation. Our team provides expert legal guidance across a wide range of matters — including family-based green cards, deportation defense, personal injury claims, and workers' compensation — with a strong emphasis on client satisfaction, clear communication, and personalized service in multiple languages. title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description: Gemini Group (csigemini.Com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.Com The Role The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group. In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations. As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini’s M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini’s deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization. Key Outcomes Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals. Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs. Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini’s M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities. Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals. Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams. Support the long-term build-out of Gemini’s LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development. Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal. Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation. Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit. Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time. Relevant Experience & Competencies At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector. Experience in outbound deal origination planning. Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities. Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development. Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments. Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously. Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency. Other Requirements Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal. Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required. Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.

title: Data & Transportation Analyst - Advanced English
description:
About HCLTech HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving. To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit Overall Responsibilities: The Transportation Specialist will be responsible for supporting our e-Commerce Transportation Operation for North America. The specialist will work with carriers, customers and internal stakeholders to execute daily transportation management functions following documented SOPs and providing status updates to the hiring manager. Core Responsibilities 1. Data Analysis & Shipment Integrity (Primary Focus) - Proactive Monitoring: Query large datasets to identify lagging or\ "at-risk\" shipments across sales, returns, and trade-in flows.
- Performance Reporting: Maintain and update centralized KPI boards and dashboards to ensure real-time visibility for internal stakeholders.
- SQL Management: Execute minor SQL queries to extract, filter, and audit transportation data from internal databases.
- Root Cause Analysis: Perform deep-dive investigations into weekly and monthly On-Time Delivery (OTD) fluctuations to identify systemic carrier or lane issues. 2. Transportation Operations Support (Secondary Focus) - Escalation Management: Resolve complex shipment status inquiries by collaborating with carriers (UPS, FedEx, DHL), 3PL partners, and Fulfillment teams.
- Master Data Maintenance: Support the Transportation Operations Manager in configuring and troubleshooting master data within the Transportation Management System (TMS).
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the data subject matter expert (SME) for ongoing logistics projects and process improvement initiatives. Technical Requirements - Data Handling: 1–3 years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a data-intensive operations role.
- SQL Proficiency: Ability to write and execute basic SQL queries for data extraction and manipulation.
- Advanced Tooling: Expert-level proficiency in Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, complex formulas, data cleaning).
- Visualization: Experience maintaining or updating dashboards (e.G., Tableau, Looker, or Data Studio). Operational Requirements - Industry Knowledge: Foundational understanding of parcel transportation or warehouse operations.
- Analytical Thinking: Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, identify trends in\ "noisy\" data, and propose actionable solutions.
- Communication: Strong ability to present data findings in a clear, concise manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Outstanding follow-through, time management and planning skills to deliver results.
- Able to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment as the market develops in unpredictable ways, producing high quality work and projecting a positive attitude. Preferred Skills/Qualifications: - Experience operating within a Transportation Management System (TMS).
- Prior experience working with major parcel carriers, such as DHL Express, UPS, and FedEx.
- Intermediate to Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (or Google Workspace), with working knowledge of SQL and Tableau.
- Prior Forecasting experience Location: LATAM (Must align with US PST Time Zone) Language Requirement: Advanced English Why choose us? We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance. Equality & Opportunity for All Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws

title: Power Platform Developer
description:
POSITION TITLE: Microsoft Power Platform Developer (individual contractor 6 – 12-month term with the possibility of extension, remote in Brazil) JOB OVERVIEW: Working with our IT team to develop Power Platform solutions and provide technical support for the Power Platform systems. We are seeking a skilled Microsoft Power Apps Developer to join our dynamic IT team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and supporting business applications using Microsoft Power Apps and Power Automate. This role requires a deep understanding of Power Platform, business process approval workflow, to create efficient and scalable solutions that meet our business needs. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: - Design, develop and maintain Power Platform Applications (specifically Dynamics) and related components (e.G., Power Apps, Power Automate).
- Experience writing and maintaining Power Platform flows for automation and system efficiency.
- Build APIs and integrations to connect external systems and implement business logic and flows.
- Integrate Power Platform with other Microsoft services including Power BI, and SharePoint.
- Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
- Create and maintain documentation for developed applications and processes.
- Provide technical support and troubleshooting for Power Platform solutions.
- Conduct training sessions and workshops for end-users to ensure effective utilization of developed applications.
- Working remotely cover 4 hours of US Pacific time zone (between 9:00am – 5:00pm PST). JOB QUALIFICATIONS: - Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
- Proven experience in developing applications using Microsoft Power Platform.
- Strong knowledge of Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI and API.
- Experience with Microsoft SharePoint, Microsoft Dynamics, and other Microsoft services.
- Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
- Strong communication and collaboration skills in English.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Microsoft Power Platform certification is preferred. WORK LOCATION: Remote in Brazil

title: Customer Success Specialist, Life Sciences
description: JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company. The Role As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription. Please share your resume in English. Responsibilities: Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage. Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes. Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits. Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources. Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams. Requirements: A master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines. Experience in science communications, academic outreach or other customer-facing roles is preferred. Fluent communication skills English. Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.E. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology. Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building. Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred. Why Join JoVE? You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market. You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education. Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration. Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description: Gemini Group (csigemini.Com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.Com The Role The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group. In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations. As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini's M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini's deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization. Key Outcomes Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals. Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs. Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini's M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities. Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals. Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams. Support the long-term build-out of Gemini's LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development. Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal. Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation. Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit. Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time. Relevant Experience & Competencies At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector. Experience in outbound deal origination planning. Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities. Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development. Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments. Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously. Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency. Other Requirements Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal. Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required. Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.

- Conhecimento em Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW) e Oracle Object Storage.
- Experiência com integração de dados via APIs REST e múltiplas fontes de dados heterogêneas.
- Experiência com SQL avançado e modelagem de dados (dimensional e analítica).
- Vivência com arquiteturas modernas de Data Lake em cloud, incluindo padrões de camadas de dados (medallion ou equivalente).
- Vivência com ferramentas de ETL/ELT e integração de dados.

title: English Teacher
description: Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone. If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week. What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire: Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements: Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are: Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description: Gemini Group (csigemini.Com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.Com The Role The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group. In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations. As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini’s M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini’s deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization. Key Outcomes Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals. Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs. Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini’s M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities. Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals. Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams. Support the long-term build-out of Gemini’s LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development. Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal. Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation. Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit. Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time. Relevant Experience & Competencies At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector. Experience in outbound deal origination planning. Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities. Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development. Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments. Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously. Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency. Other Requirements Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal. Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required. Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.

title: Language Specialist
description: Job Title: Language Specialist – AI Training (Freelancer) Location: Brazil (Remote – Candidates must be based in Brazil) About the Role : As a Language Specialist, you will play a vital role in training and enhancing Large Language Models (LLMs). This involves evaluating prompts, rating AI-generated outputs, and creating high-quality content to improve the accuracy, fluency, and cultural relevance of AI systems used by global technology leaders. Key Responsibilities: Evaluate AI-generated prompts and responses for linguistic accuracy, coherence, and contextual relevance. Provide structured ratings and feedback on AI outputs, highlighting errors, biases, or inconsistencies. Develop, edit, and curate high-quality content for training datasets across diverse domains. Collaborate with linguists, annotators, and AI researchers to refine model performance. Ensure cultural and linguistic nuances are accurately represented. Follow established guidelines while also suggesting improvements for evaluation frameworks. Qualifications: Strong written and spoken command of the target language, with excellent grammar and stylistic skills. Prior experience in content writing, editing, or evaluation preferred. Analytical mindset with keen attention to detail. Interest in AI, NLP, or LLMs will be an advantage.

description:

title: English Teacher
description: Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone. If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week. What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire: Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements: Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are: Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Senior Devops Engineer (Kubernetes & Cloud Infrastructure) Pj
description: Qual será o seu papel? Administração de Ambientes Híbridos: Gerenciar e implantar clusters Kubernetes tanto em ambientes On-Premises (usando kubeadm) quanto em nuvens públicas. Gestão de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Provisionar e manter recursos de infraestrutura utilizando Terraform e Ansible, garantindo a escalabilidade do ambiente. Otimização e Segurança de Containers: Criar e otimizar imagens Docker, além de gerenciar políticas de segurança, RBAC, quotas e namespaces no ecossistema Kubernetes. Sustentação e Troubleshooting: Diagnosticar e resolver problemas complexos em pods, nós e serviços, utilizando ferramentas nativas e CLI de nuvem. Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Implementar e analisar métricas e logs para garantir a saúde dos clusters e identificar gargalos de performance (CPU, memória, IOPS) de forma proativa. Esperamos que você tenha: Domínio de Kubernetes: Experiência avançada em configuração de redes (CNI/Cilium), serviços (LoadBalancer, Ingress) e Service Mesh (Istio). Experiência com Armazenamento: Sólido conhecimento em PVs, PVCs e provisionadores de storage (Ceph, NFS ou nativos de nuvem como EBS/Azure Disk). Fluência em Automação e CI/CD: Experiência prática na construção de pipelines e integração de automações com GitLab CI/CD e ArgoCD. Conhecimento em Observabilidade: Experiência técnica com a stack Prometheus, Grafana e Alertmanager, além de gestão de logs (Fluentd, Loki, Elasticsearch). Habilidade com IaC e Helm: Proficiência em Terraform, Ansible e no empacotamento/deploy de aplicações via Helm Charts. Vamos ficar felizes se você tiver (seu diferencial): Multicloud: Vivência em múltiplos provedores de nuvem (GCP, OCI, AWS, Azure). Foco em Segurança: Experiência avançada na implementação de políticas de segurança de rede e endurecimento (hardening) de imagens Docker. Mentalidade Proativa: Capacidade comprovada de antecipar incidentes graves através da análise técnica de recursos de infraestrutura. Certificações nos provedores de Cloud (OCI, AWS, GCP, Azure) Contratação: PJ.

title: Freight Desk Manager
description: Position Scope The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region. This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets. Responsibilities and Accountabilities Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding. Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers. Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency. Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards. Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments. Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes. Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency. Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs. Mandatory Requirements Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments. Regional Expertise: Deep knowledge of the LATAM logistics landscape, including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks. Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes. Network Management: Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and\ "Control Tower\" operationalmodels. Technical Proficiency: Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments. Leadership: Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR). Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field. Languages: Fluency in English is essential for regional and global coordination. Desirable Requirements Advanced Education: MBA or Master’s degree. Process Excellence: Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience. Digital Transformation: Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools. Rapid Growth Background: Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.G., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

title: Data Engineer Revenue Management
description: Data Engineer Revenue Management Remote (send your resume in English) A Iron Mountain está em busca de um Data Engineer Revenue Management motivado(a) e com fluência/nível avançado no idioma inglês para se juntar à nossa equipe de Global Revenue Management (Gestão de Receita Global). Neste cargo, você será responsável por projetar, implementar e manter pipelines de dados escaláveis para garantir dados limpos e acessíveis, transformando dados brutos em insights que impulsionam a melhor segmentação de clientes. Você fará parte de uma equipe de alto impacto dedicada a direcionar a estratégia de preços global para atingir nossas metas de receita e lucro, exigindo coordenação entre as regiões da América do Norte, Europa e América Latina. O Que Você Fará Desenvolver Arquiteturas de Dados Escaláveis: Projetar e manter pipelines de Extraction, Transformation, and Loading (Extração, Transformação e Carregamento - ETL) integrando dados de sistemas operacionais globais usando tecnologias Amazon Web Services (AWS) e Structured Query Language (SQL). Otimizar Processos e Automação: Identificar e implementar melhorias nos processos internos, redesenhando a infraestrutura para maior escalabilidade e automatizando processos manuais para fornecer conjuntos de dados selecionados para análises e painéis operacionais. Garantir a Excelência Operacional e Governança: Monitorar o desempenho e a qualidade dos pipelines, implementando testes automatizados e padrões de governança de dados alinhados às políticas de segurança da informação da empresa. O candidato ideal terá: fluência/nível avançado no idioma inglês 3 a 5 anos ou mais de experiência em engenharia de dados, com foco em construção de pipelines em ambientes corporativos de grande escala. Sólido conhecimento técnico em modelagem de dados, Structured Query Language (SQL) e proficiência em linguagens de programação como Python ou Scala. Capacidade comprovada em processamento de dados distribuídos (ex: Spark) e no uso de plataformas em nuvem para extração e carregamento de conjuntos de dados complexos. Bacharelado ou Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou área relacionada. O Que Oferecemos (Benefícios) Localização: Opções de trabalho remoto ou híbrido para apoiar o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional. Equilíbrio e Bem-Estar: Programa de férias e dias de folga remunerados. Segurança e Futuro: Planos abrangentes de saúde, bem-estar e previdência privada. Desenvolvimento Contínuo: Oportunidades de aprendizado constante e crescimento profissional em uma organização líder global. Pronto para ajudar a proteger e desbloquear o valor da informação? Candidate-se hoje mesmo para integrar nossa equipe de Global Revenue Management e construir as bases de dados do futuro!

description:
Banco de Talentos | Inteligência Artificial (IA) & Machine Learning Engineer Estamos construindo um banco de talentos com foco em profissionais de Inteligência Artificial (IA), com ênfase em IA Generativa e Engenharia de Machine Learning, em diferentes níveis de senioridade (Júnior, Pleno, Sênior e Especialista/Tech Lead), que desejam atuar em projetos inovadores, com alto impacto no negócio e uso de tecnologias de ponta. Experiência com IA Generativa (LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, etc.);

Experiência com manipulação e análise de dados (Pandas, NumPy, SQL);

Experiência com ambientes cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP);
Familiaridade com práticas de MLOps (deploy, monitoramento, versionamento de modelos);
Experiência com versionamento de código (Git);
Certificações em IA, dados ou cloud serão consideradas um diferencial. Perfil que valorizamos Forte capacidade analítica e pensamento crítico;
Perfil híbridoentre dados e engenharia de software;
Proatividade eautonomia na resolução de problemas;
Curiosidade e interesse por inovação e novas tecnologias;
Colaboração com times multidisciplinares;
Capacidade de atuar emambientes dinâmicos e orientados à experimentação;
Foco em geração de valor a partir de soluções inteligentes. Se identificou? Cadastre-se no nosso banco de talentos e fique por dentro das oportunidades que podem surgir

description: Oportunidade: Coordenador de Obras (Incorporação) Estamos em busca de um Coordenador de Obras com perfil dinâmico e visão estratégica para integrar nosso time de Engenharia. Este profissional será o elo entre o planejamento da incorporadora e a execução técnica no canteiro, garantindo que nossos empreendimentos sejam entregues com excelência, dentro do prazo e do orçamento. Formação: Graduação completa em Engenharia Civil com registro ativo no CREA. Controle de Cronograma: Monitorar o caminho crítico das obras, antecipar riscos e propor planos de ação para desvios de prazo. Gestão de Custos: Acompanhar o fluxo de caixa das obras e o cumprimento do orçamento previsto (VGV/Custos diretos). Liderança de Equipes: Orientar os engenheiros residentes e equipes técnicas, promovendo um ambiente de alta performance e segurança. Qualidade e Normas: Garantir o cumprimento das normas técnicas, PBQP-H e legislações municipais vigentes. Pré-requisitos Adicionais e Diferenciais Softwares de Gestão: Domínio de ferramentas de planejamento ( MS Project ou Primavera) e ERPs de engenharia (Ex: Sienge, UAU ou Totvs). Metodologias Ágeis: Conhecimento em Lean Construction (Construção Enxuta) para otimização de processos. Gestão de Contratos: Habilidade na contratação e gestão de grandes empreiteiras e fornecedores críticos. Pós-Graduação: Especialização em Gestão de Projetos, Gestão de Negócios Imobiliários ou Engenharia de Custos será considerada um diferencial. Perfil Comportamental: Forte capacidade de negociação, resiliência para lidar com prazos desafiadores e excelente comunicação interpessoal.

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Freight Desk Manager
description: Position Scope The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region. This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets. Responsibilities and Accountabilities Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding. Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers. Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency. Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards. Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments. Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes. Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency. Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs. Mandatory Requirements Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments. Regional Expertise: Deep knowledge of the LATAM logistics landscape, including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks. Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes. Network Management: Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and\ "Control Tower\" operationalmodels. Technical Proficiency: Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments. Leadership: Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR). Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field. Languages: Fluency in English is essential for regional and global coordination. Desirable Requirements Advanced Education: MBA or Master’s degree. Process Excellence: Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience. Digital Transformation: Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools. Rapid Growth Background: Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.G., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:

We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026
