title: Senior Helpdesk Support Specialist
description: Position OverviewAs a senior member of our IT support team, you will provide advanced, second-level technical assistance to end-users, resolving complex issues related to computer hardware, software, and systems within a Windows-based environment. A significant component of this position involves coaching, mentoring, and providing technical guidance to Level 1 help desk technicians, contributing directly to the team's growth and the achievement of leadership goals. You will serve as a key escalation point, performing in-depth diagnostics, implementing solutions, and managing small IT projects. Key responsibilities include basic network connectivity triage for LAN, WAN, and wireless access points, asset management administration, and maintaining a comprehensive knowledge base to enable proactive problem resolution. This role requires performing basic Active Directory tasks, Microsoft 365 troubleshooting, and device management using Microsoft Intune, ensuring the daily performance and stability of our computer systems. Position title: Senior Helpdesk Support SpecialistLocation: Remote - LATAMKey ResponsibilitiesHelp supervise ticket flow in Jira, ensuring proper triage, routing, and escalation. Mentor, coach, and provide technical guidance to Level 1 helpdesk technicians to support their professional development and ensure overall team success. Serve as the primary escalation point for complex end-user IT issues, providing advanced second-level support for computer systems, hardware, and software. Manage small-scale IT projects, overseeing tasks and special assignments to ensure successful completion and alignment with departmental objectives. Proactively identify recurring technical problems, implementing permanent solutions and making recommendations for IT improvements to reduce incident volume. Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues by installing, modifying, and repairing computer software, and peripherals on Windows operating systems. Perform basic network triage for Local Area Networks (LAN), Wide Area Networks (WAN), and wireless access points to resolve initial connectivity issues before escalation. Execute fundamental administrative tasks in Active Directory, such as account unlocks and password resets, and provide end-user troubleshooting for Microsoft 365 applications. Utilize Microsoft Intune for key device management functions. Administer the IT asset management system, ensuring accurate tracking and documentation of software assets. Develop, preserve, and grow a comprehensive knowledge base of procedures and solutions for both internal help desk use and end-user self-help resources. Strong documentation discipline and ability to follow and improve SOPs and knowledge base articles Design and conduct training sessions for computer users to enhance their technical proficiency and understanding of IT systems. Manage and progress tickets in Jira Service Management, including triage, updates, proper routing, and escalation. Basic familiarity with endpoint security and antivirus concepts is helpful, issues are typically escalated to the appropriate security team. Required Skills & ExperienceProven experience providing remote help desk and desktop support, including diagnosing, guiding, and resolving issues related to computer hardware, software, and peripherals through virtual and phone-based assistance. Demonstrated leadership abilities, including experience providing technical guidance, coaching, and mentoring to junior help desk technicians. Working knowledge of help desk software and remote control tools. Experience working in Jira Service Management, or strong experience with similar ITSM ticketing systems and workflows. Experience with basic Active Directory user management, such as password changes and account unlocks, and providing end-user troubleshooting for Microsoft 365. Proficiency in resolving basic connectivity issues for Local Area Networks (LAN), Wide Area Networks (WAN), and wireless access points through basic triage. Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to develop training materials and maintain a knowledge base. Proven ability to manage small IT projects and perform asset management administration. Familiarity with Microsoft Intune for device enrollment. Nice to Have SkillsProfessional IT certifications, such as CompTIA A+, Network+, or Microsoft IT Support. Familiarity with Microsoft Intune for device enrollment via Windows Autopilot and performing machine resets. Experience with PowerShell scripting to automate routine administrative tasks. Knowledge of supporting additional operating systems, such as macOS, iOS, or Android. Experience with advanced network troubleshooting using command-line tools. Soft SkillsDemonstrated leadership capabilities, with a focus on coaching, mentoring, and providing technical guidance to junior team members to foster their growth and ensure overall team success. Exceptional communication skills (verbal, written, and presentation), with the ability to convey complex technical solutions clearly to clients of varying proficiency levels and to conduct effective training sessions. Advanced analytical and troubleshooting abilities, characterized by a proactive approach to not only resolve immediate issues but also to identify root causes and implement solutions that prevent future occurrences. A strong client-centric mindset, demonstrating the ability to understand problems from the user's perspective and guide them through the resolution process with patience and clarity. Proven ability to work effectively within a high-performing team environment, collaborating with colleagues and assisting other IT support teams to share knowledge and achieve common goals. Excellent organizational and multitasking skills, including the ability to manage small IT projects, maintain meticulous attention to detail, and exercise sound judgment in tracking, routing, and escalating support tickets. Why You Will Love Working with UsJoin a powerful tech workforce and help us change the world through technology Professional development opportunities with international customers Collaborative work environment Career path and mentorship programs that will lead to new levels. Join Lean Tech and contribute to shaping the data landscape within a dynamic and growing organization. Your skills will be honed, and your contributions will play a vital role in our continued success. Lean Tech is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusiveenvironment for all employees.

title: Service Manager
description: At OSF Digital, we are looking for a dynamic and proactive Service Manager to lead and optimize IT service delivery operations. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing service management strategies, ensuring high-quality service delivery, maintaining strong client relationships, and driving continuous improvement initiatives aligned with business objectives. Responsibilities: Develop and implement service management strategies and plans to ensure high-quality service delivery. Oversee service delivery teams, providing leadership, guidance, and performance support. Monitor and manage SLAs and KPIs, ensuring agreed targets are consistently met or exceeded. Analyze service performance metrics and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Manage and resolve service-related issues and escalations in a timely and effective manner. Act as the primary point of contact for clients regarding service delivery matters. Collaborate with project managers, technical teams, and stakeholders to align service operations with company goals. Prepare and present service performance reports to senior management and clients. Contribute to the evolution of service management practices, tools, and processes. Requirements: Proven experience as a Service Manager or in a similar IT service delivery role. Strong experience managing SLAs, KPIs, and service management strategies. Solid leadership and team management skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Proficiency in service management tools and structured operational processes. Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field. ITIL certification or equivalent service management qualification is highly desirable. Fluency in English and Portuguese is required. Benefits: Discover OSF’s benefits and programs!

title: Senior Business Analyst - Supply Chain
description:
Who We Are We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation. Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations. Who We Are Looking For We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain, a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution). This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts. If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply. Key Responsibilities Business Requirements & Client Engagement - Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.
- Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.
- Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.
- Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.
- Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies. Solution Design, Implementation & Testing - Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).
- Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.
- Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.
- Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.
- Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.
- Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.
- Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.
- Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption. Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%) - Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.
- Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.
- Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices. Must Have - Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.
- Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).
- Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.
- Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).
- Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.
- Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
- Experience with project management and collaboration tools.
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.
- Availability to travel.
- Legally authorized to work in Brazil. What We Offer - Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.
- A collaborative and international work environment.
- Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects. Why Hoist? If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you. Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Onboarding Specialist - Contractor

Our mission is to develop the next generation of Conversational AI, empowering customer interactions across all channels—from messaging to voice—and enhancing business workflows and processes. Our platform seamlessly integrates with popular channels such as WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, WeChat, and more, providing comprehensive communication solutions. With our AI customer engagement platform, enterprises can automate growth by enhancing productivity across their sales, marketing, and support teams. As we aggressively expand into emerging markets, we seek adventurous, diverse, and passionate individuals to join us on this exciting journey. Join our team and grow your career with SleekFlow! Providing materials to help customers learn best practices to achieve their desired outcomes faster and more efficiently. Work with sales, product, and support teams to ensure that each piece of the journey meets customer expectations. Handle incoming enquiries via emails, calls and chats in a professional manner. Build evergreen content and resources for customers (and other organizations) to use for education and to drive rapid product adoption. Be a SleekFlow expert and discuss or educate on any nuance of the product internally and externally. Work continuously to document the details of each interaction in order to easily research customer issues and to inform product improvements Skills and Qualifications Good command of both written and spoken Portuguese and English Minimum of 1 year of experience in communications, customer service and support, sales, account management, or customer success. Customer success courses / training are good to have. Ability to learn, adapt and thrive quickly in a dynamic environment Comfortable to engage with a diverse array of customers Problem solving and critical thinking with detail oriented Strong stakeholder management and communication skills (written & verbal) Strong customer obsession attitude with evidence of taking independent and appropriate decisions for the customer Strong computer skills, including CRM, Microsoft Word, PowerPoint and Excel. title: Professor De Espanhol
description: Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil! Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares! A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada. Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história. Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT* O que oferecemos? Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Necessário: Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Senior Helpdesk Support Specialist
description: Position OverviewAs a senior member of our IT support team, you will provide advanced, second-level technical assistance to end-users, resolving complex issues related to computer hardware, software, and systems within a Windows-based environment. A significant component of this position involves coaching, mentoring, and providing technical guidance to Level 1 help desk technicians, contributing directly to the team's growth and the achievement of leadership goals. You will serve as a key escalation point, performing in-depth diagnostics, implementing solutions, and managing small IT projects. Key responsibilities include basic network connectivity triage for LAN, WAN, and wireless access points, asset management administration, and maintaining a comprehensive knowledge base to enable proactive problem resolution. This role requires performing basic Active Directory tasks, Microsoft 365 troubleshooting, and device management using Microsoft Intune, ensuring the daily performance and stability of our computer systems. Position title: Senior Helpdesk Support SpecialistLocation: Remote - LATAMKey ResponsibilitiesHelp supervise ticket flow in Jira, ensuring proper triage, routing, and escalation. Mentor, coach, and provide technical guidance to Level 1 helpdesk technicians to support their professional development and ensure overall team success. Serve as the primary escalation point for complex end-user IT issues, providing advanced second-level support for computer systems, hardware, and software. Manage small-scale IT projects, overseeing tasks and special assignments to ensure successful completion and alignment with departmental objectives. Proactively identify recurring technical problems, implementing permanent solutions and making recommendations for IT improvements to reduce incident volume. Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues by installing, modifying, and repairing computer software, and peripherals on Windows operating systems. Perform basic network triage for Local Area Networks (LAN), Wide Area Networks (WAN), and wireless access points to resolve initial connectivity issues before escalation. Execute fundamental administrative tasks in Active Directory, such as account unlocks and password resets, and provide end-user troubleshooting for Microsoft 365 applications. Utilize Microsoft Intune for key device management functions. Administer the IT asset management system, ensuring accurate tracking and documentation of software assets. Develop, preserve, and grow a comprehensive knowledge base of procedures and solutions for both internal help desk use and end-user self-help resources. Strong documentation discipline and ability to follow and improve SOPs and knowledge base articles Design and conduct training sessions for computer users to enhance their technical proficiency and understanding of IT systems. Manage and progress tickets in Jira Service Management, including triage, updates, proper routing, and escalation. Basic familiarity with endpoint security and antivirus concepts is helpful, issues are typically escalated to the appropriate security team. Required Skills & ExperienceProven experience providing remote help desk and desktop support, including diagnosing, guiding, and resolving issues related to computer hardware, software, and peripherals through virtual and phone-based assistance. Demonstrated leadership abilities, including experience providing technical guidance, coaching, and mentoring to junior help desk technicians. Working knowledge of help desk software and remote control tools. Experience working in Jira Service Management, or strong experience with similar ITSM ticketing systems and workflows. Experience with basic Active Directory user management, such as password changes and account unlocks, and providing end-user troubleshooting for Microsoft 365. Proficiency in resolving basic connectivity issues for Local Area Networks (LAN), Wide Area Networks (WAN), and wireless access points through basic triage. Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to develop training materials and maintain a knowledge base. Proven ability to manage small IT projects and perform asset management administration. Familiarity with Microsoft Intune for device enrollment. Nice to Have SkillsProfessional IT certifications, such as CompTIA A+, Network+, or Microsoft IT Support. Familiarity with Microsoft Intune for device enrollment via Windows Autopilot and performing machine resets. Experience with PowerShell scripting to automate routine administrative tasks. Knowledge of supporting additional operating systems, such as macOS, iOS, or Android. Experience with advanced network troubleshooting using command-line tools. Soft SkillsDemonstrated leadership capabilities, with a focus on coaching, mentoring, and providing technical guidance to junior team members to foster their growth and ensure overall team success. Exceptional communication skills (verbal, written, and presentation), with the ability to convey complex technical solutions clearly to clients of varying proficiency levels and to conduct effective training sessions. Advanced analytical and troubleshooting abilities, characterized by a proactive approach to not only resolve immediate issues but also to identify root causes and implement solutions that prevent future occurrences. A strong client-centric mindset, demonstrating the ability to understand problems from the user's perspective and guide them through the resolution process with patience and clarity. Proven ability to work effectively within a high-performing team environment, collaborating with colleagues and assisting other IT support teams to share knowledge and achieve common goals. Excellent organizational and multitasking skills, including the ability to manage small IT projects, maintain meticulous attention to detail, and exercise sound judgment in tracking, routing, and escalating support tickets. Why You Will Love Working with UsJoin a powerful tech workforce and help us change the world through technology Professional development opportunities with international customers Collaborative work environment Career path and mentorship programs that will lead to new levels. Join Lean Tech and contribute to shaping the data landscape within a dynamic and growing organization. Your skills will be honed, and your contributions will play a vital role in our continued success. Lean Tech is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusiveenvironment for all employees.

title: Vmware Vcf Consultant

Produce documentation and operational handoff materials. Support DR architecture and testing. Provide knowledge transfer to customers and internal teams. Requirements 10+ years of IT experience MUST BE fluent in English MUST BE an expert in VMWare Cloud Foundation Experience with VCF or large‑scale VMware deployments. Exposure to AWS/Azure/GCP and hybrid integrations. Knowledge of backup/storage platforms like PowerStore or Veeam. Previous experience in Consulting and/or client facing roles

title: Engenheiro De Ia Sênior
description:
A Atos é uma empresa líder mundial em transformação digital, oferecendo serviços de transação de alta tecnologia, consultoria, integração de sistemas, cloud e serviços gerenciados. Além disso, anunciada como parceira mundial de TI nos Jogos Olímpicos e Paraolímpicos! Presente em mais de 70 países e com aproximadamente 100.000 especialistas ao redor do mundo, nossa empresa está no novo ranking Digital 100 da Forbes, uma lista das principais empresas de capital aberto que moldam o mundo digital nas áreas de Tecnologia da Informação (TI), hardware, mídia, e-commerce e telecomunicações. Engenheiro de IA Sênior Estamos buscando um Engenheiro de IA Sênior para se juntar ao nosso time no desenvolvimento de soluções de IA. Aqui não tem monotonia. Somos um time de solucionadores de desafios de clientes de grande porte nos mais diversos mercados. Com desafios tão diversos, precisamos de pessoas que tenham uma boa base teórica de IA, experiência diversificada em projetos reais e a habilidade de resolver problemas novos com autonomia. Requisitos: Experiência na área de IA OU na área de desenvolvimento de software com com vivência na área de IA;
Experiência em conduzir projetos junto ao cliente, desde o levantamento de requisitos até as decisões técnicas;
Habilidades de comunicação e liderança para apoiar o crescimento de profissionais com menos experiência do time;
Graduação emcursos daárea de computação OU Pós-graduação na área de IA e experiência prévia como analista de sistemas;
Ter desenvolvido ao menos um projeto real com IA Generativa (não vale só prompt engineering, ok?);
Experiência com desenvolvimento de soluções em ambiente de cloud, preferencialmente GCP ou Azure;
Python fluente;
Inglês avançado (ao menos para leitura e compreensão oral). Desejável: Experiência previa como analista de sistemas;

title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
description: About the Job As Silicon Valley Consulting we help companies improve their ads by building custom martech solutions. You'll be working for Silicon Valley Consulting's child company TGA Fund. ( TGA Fund is a high-ownership venture builder studio that invests in startups and creates new startups in-house. We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineering Manager to join our team! This is not a generic engineering management role. We need an engineer, first who is a hands on platform leader, reliable and decisive, with great communication skills. This is a high-ownership role where you’ll lead critical platform initiatives, scale high-performing teams, and shape the technical foundations of upcoming projects/products. You'll get to manage multiple SaaS products via the engineering team that you'll lead. You also get revenue share from the products you'll manage via the engineering team. You Will: Be in charge of the given quarterly budget, dictating how many engineering contractors that you can/want to have on the team. Interview engineering candidates. Code during crunch times. What You’ll Bring: (Preferred qualifications) Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience. Proficiency with backend service technologies (e. g., Java, Go, Javascript), RESTful API development, and modern engineering best practices. Experience with data systems (SQL/NoSQL), messaging technologies (e. g., Kafka), containerized environments (e. g., Kubernetes) and UI technologies. Familiarity with AI/ML ecosystems, including large language models, agentic AI, or AI productivity tools. Typically 4+ years of engineering experience with at least 1 years leading multiple teams and senior level engineering talent Solid understanding of system design, architecture principles, UI frameworks, and API driven ecosystems. Experience building or contributing to largescale marketplace or platform products. Strong problem solving abilities and familiarity with SDLC, CI/CD, observability, and production operations. Ability to partner across teamsand operate effectively in dynamic or ambiguous situations. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Commitment to fostering a healthy, inclusive team culture focused on quality, accountability, and continuous learning. If we like you, you'll be given a 90-day trial period. Please do not forget that this is a part-time role. Base pay during trial period: $280 USD to $500 USD per month (part-time) Benefits: Bonuses come from Revenue Sharing + Profit Sharing We also give you the opportunity to bring in your own ideas. If you have a project you want to realize, and believe it can benefit from our support, then you can always ask for a vote. If your idea passes the vote, we will partner with your dream and scale it with you. Why Us? We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. SVC and TGA Fund invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our organizations. We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status. Application: Please fill out the Google Form below in order to apply: Tip: Please take your time and answer these questions thoroughly. We know that many companies make you take pre-assesments and never read them. We actually do! We care about this role and if your responses are good you are guaranteed an interview. Don't use AI to answer any of these. If you're an actual (senior) engineer manager, you'll know how frustrating it is to read 500 responses that all sound the same.

Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders. Attention to Detail: A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform. Benefits Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements. Flexible work environment. Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Back End Developer
description:
About EverUp We’re a UK startup making gift-card shopping rewarding. Our mobile app (React Native) and web (React) run on a serverless AWS backend. We’re hiring a Backend Cloud Engineer to evolve and maintain the APIs, databases, and services that power payments, wallet, rewards, and near-real-time features. The role You’ll work across our event-driven, serverless stack to maintain and evolve production systems. That means adding features, fixing bugs, improving performance and cost, tightening security, and raising reliability—while collaborating closely with Mobile/Web. What you’ll do Maintain and evolve AWS Lambda microservices behind Amazon API Gateway (HTTP/REST & WebSocket) and AWS IoT Core ;
implement authentication/authorization via Cognito User Pools (JWT) and Lambda authorizers for REST/HTTP. Maintain and optimize data models and access patterns in DynamoDB and MySQL (RDS);
handle indexes, migrations, and query performance. Maintain asynchronous workflows using SQS/SNS (idempotency, DLQs, retries) and keep observability healthy with CloudWatch metrics/logs and alarms. Maintain and improve our IaC (AWS SAM/CloudFormation), CI/CD pipelines, and environment promotions. Integrate and support third-party services used for payments, open banking, notifications, fraud/risk, analytics and support tooling. Troubleshoot production issues, drive RCAs, and implement preventive fixes and runbooks. Uphold security best practices (least-privilege IAM, secret management, input validation, auditability). Tech you’ll touch AWS Lambda, API Gateway (REST/WebSocket), Cognito, DynamoDB, RDS MySQL, SQS/SNS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, CloudFormation/SAM, EC2, ECS, plus fintech/comms integrations (Open Banking/PSP, Gift Cards, Analytics, Messaging, Support, and Risk assessment tools). Must-haves 8+ years building/maintaining production backends;
4+ years with AWS serverless (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB). Proficiency in JavaScript/Node.Js;
strong REST API fundamentals and event-driven patterns. Solid SQL/NoSQL skills (schema design, indexing, query tuning). Experience maintaining IaC (SAM/CloudFormation) and CI/CD (Code Pipeline). Security-first mindset and practical debugging/troubleshooting chops (OWASP). WebSocket/API Gateway connection management and real-time features. Payments/fintech and fraud/risk integrations. Observability practices (dashboards, tracing, log correlation) and SLOs. Elastic Beanstalk familiarity and data pipelines/warehousing exposure. How we work Remote-first within UK time zone, startup-paced, with high ownership. We value clean code, small safe changes, and excellent operability. Hiring process Intro call Technical deep-dive (systems design discussions focused on maintainability and evolution) Practical walkthrough (IaC/API/data-modeling maintenance scenario) Founder/lead chat & references Equal opportunity We’re an equal-opportunity employer and welcome every background and perspective. How to apply Send your CV, GitHub/portfolio, and a brief note describing a production backend you maintained/evolved and the reliability or cost improvements you delivered.

title: Desenvolvedor Servicenow | Especialista Técnico De Aplicações
description: Descrição da Vaga (JD): O desenvolvedor ServiceNow fará parte de uma equipe já estabelecida, apoiando a implementação do módulo Application Portfolio Management (APM) do ServiceNow. title: Data Operations Analyst
description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It’s Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data. You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have… 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus. What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness package Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

implement authentication/authorization via Cognito User Pools (JWT) and Lambda authorizers for REST/HTTP. Maintain and optimize data models and access patterns in DynamoDB and MySQL (RDS);
handle indexes, migrations, and query performance. Maintain asynchronous workflows using SQS/SNS (idempotency, DLQs, retries) and keep observability healthy with CloudWatch metrics/logs and alarms. Maintain and improve our IaC (AWS SAM/CloudFormation), CI/CD pipelines, and environment promotions. Integrate and support third-party services used for payments, open banking, notifications, fraud/risk, analytics and support tooling. Troubleshoot production issues, drive RCAs, and implement preventive fixes and runbooks. Uphold security best practices (least-privilege IAM, secret management, input validation, auditability). Tech you’ll touch AWS Lambda, API Gateway (REST/WebSocket), Cognito, DynamoDB, RDS MySQL, SQS/SNS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, CloudFormation/SAM, EC2, ECS, plus fintech/comms integrations (Open Banking/PSP, Gift Cards, Analytics, Messaging, Support, and Risk assessment tools). Must-haves 8+ years building/maintaining production backends;
4+ years with AWS serverless (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB). Proficiency in JavaScript/Node.Js;
strong REST API fundamentals and event-driven patterns. Solid SQL/NoSQL skills (schema design, indexing, query tuning). Experience maintaining IaC (SAM/CloudFormation) and CI/CD (Code Pipeline). Security-first mindset and practical debugging/troubleshooting chops (OWASP). WebSocket/API Gateway connection management and real-time features. Payments/fintech and fraud/risk integrations. Observability practices (dashboards, tracing, log correlation) and SLOs. Elastic Beanstalk familiarity and data pipelines/warehousing exposure. How we work Remote-first within UK time zone, startup-paced, with high ownership. We value clean code, small safe changes, and excellent operability. Hiring process Intro call Technical deep-dive (systems design discussions focused on maintainability and evolution) Practical walkthrough (IaC/API/data-modeling maintenance scenario) Founder/lead chat & references Equal opportunity We’re an equal-opportunity employer and welcome every background and perspective. How to apply Send your CV, GitHub/portfolio, and a brief note describing a production backend you maintained/evolved and the reliability or cost improvements you delivered.

description:
About Turing: Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge;
and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies. Role Overview: We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world! What does day-to-day look like: You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn: Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?) In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.G. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed. Requirements: Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German) Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities. Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours. Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection. Preferred Qualifications: Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area. Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.) Understanding of Excel and Google Suite. Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable. Perks of Freelancing With Turing: Work in a fully remote environment. Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies. Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs. Offer Details: Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave) Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Strategic Partnership & Alliance
description: About RateGain RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day. Exploring the role RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business. The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond. This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations. How your day will look like/Job responsibility Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.G. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs) Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with RateGain’s GTM strategy in LATAM Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements Represent RateGain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends Education & Work Experience Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field 5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships Knowledge: In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem Knowledge of SaaS business models and partnership structures Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors Skills: Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.) Attitude: Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment Equal Opportunity Employer We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
description: About the Job As Silicon Valley Consulting we help companies improve their ads by building custom martech solutions. You'll be working for Silicon Valley Consulting's child company TGA Fund. ( TGA Fund is a high-ownership venture builder studio that invests in startups and creates new startups in-house. We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineering Manager to join our team! This is not a generic engineering management role. We need an engineer, first who is a hands on platform leader, reliable and decisive, with great communication skills. This is a high-ownership role where you’ll lead critical platform initiatives, scale high-performing teams, and shape the technical foundations of upcoming projects/products. You'll get to manage multiple SaaS products via the engineering team that you'll lead. You also get revenue share from the products you'll manage via the engineering team. What You’ll Bring: (Preferred qualifications) Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience. Proficiency with backend service technologies (e. g., Java, Go, Javascript), RESTful API development, and modern engineering best practices. Experience with data systems (SQL/NoSQL), messaging technologies (e. g., Kafka), containerized environments (e. g., Kubernetes) and UI technologies. Familiarity with AI/ML ecosystems, including large language models, agentic AI, or AI productivity tools. Typically 4+ years of engineering experience with at least 1 years leading multiple teams and senior level engineering talent Solid understanding of system design, architecture principles, UI frameworks, and API driven ecosystems. Experience building or contributing to largescale marketplace or platform products. Strong problem solving abilities and familiarity with SDLC, CI/CD, observability, and production operations. Ability to partner across teamsand operate effectively in dynamic or ambiguous situations. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Commitment to fostering a healthy, inclusive team culture focused on quality, accountability, and continuous learning. If we like you, you'll be given a 90-day trial period. Please do not forget that this is a part-time role. Base pay during trial period: $280 USD to $500 USD per month (part-time) Benefits: Bonuses come from Revenue Sharing + Profit Sharing We also give you the opportunity to bring in your own ideas. If you have a project you want to realize, and believe it can benefit from our support, then you can always ask for a vote. If your idea passes the vote, we will partner with your dream and scale it with you. Why Us? We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. SVC and TGA Fund invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our organizations. We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status. Application: Please fill out the Google Form below in order to apply: Tip: Please take your time and answer these questions thoroughly. We know that many companies make you take pre-assesments and never read them. We actually do! We care about this role and if your responses are good you are guaranteed an interview. Don't use AI to answer any of these. If you're an actual (senior) engineer manager, you'll know how frustrating it is to read 500 responses that all sound the same.

We built an internal platform that combines AI-powered chat, a knowledge base, automated workflows, a live data warehouse with KPI dashboards, content validation, and team integrations. It is live and used daily. We have a strong product vision and a clear roadmap. What we need is a smart, adaptable developer who can execute — someone who can take direction from the founder and turn priorities into shipped software. You do not need to be a machine learning researcher, but you do need to be an expert at using AI coding tools. Claude Code is our primary development workflow, and you should already use it (or similar tools) daily on real work. Strong general understanding of how modern AI systems work is required. What you will do: Ship production features across the full stack (Python, TypeScript/React, SQL) Build and extend features using AI-assisted development tools Maintain data pipelines and analytics layers Own infrastructure, deployment, monitoring, and reliability Work directly with the founder to turn business needs into working software What we are looking for: Engineering degree and solid programming fundamentals Comfortable with Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, and SQL Experience building or maintaining production web applications Expert with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) — daily user, not a beginner Strong working understanding of how modern AI tools and LLMs actually work Self-directed, resourceful, and a fast learner Professional English proficiency (written and spoken) Nice to have: React/Next.Js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, data pipelines, cloud deployment, AI/LLM API experience This is the first dedicated engineering hire for the platform. You will be the technical owner, not a cog in a team. Remote, real autonomy, real ownership. If you are a smart developer who learns fast and wants to own a production system at a fast-moving company, we want to talk.

e produtos digitais, TotalPass e Queima Diária. Principais responsabilidades: 1. Estratégia de Testes: Definir a política de cobertura de testes e garantir que o time utilize mocks e ferramentas como VCR para manter a agilidade no desenvolvimento. 3. Sustentação, Suporte e Performance Atendimento de Chamados Nível 3: Atuar como ponto focal em problemas complexos de produção, realizando a análise de causa raiz e orientando o time na correção definitiva. Otimização Contínua: Monitorar gargalos de performance no servidor e no banco de dados, implementando melhorias proativas para suportar o crescimento do app. 4. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua Radar Tecnológico: Manter o time atualizado com as novas versões do Ruby e do Rails, avaliando quando migrar ou adotar novas práticas. Cultura de Inovação Pragmática: Estimular o uso de ferramentas de IA para ganho de produtividade, sem abrir mão da segurança e da qualidade do código. O que buscamos Pessoas que: Dominem Arquitetura de Sistemas com Ruby on Rails: Domínio profundo de Rails em modo API e Monolitos, com habilidade para desenhar arquiteturas escaláveis, modulares e de fácil manutenção. Têm experiência com Modelagem e Performance de Dados: Maestria em PostgreSQL, otimização de queries, gestão de índices e estratégias de cache (Redis) para suportar aplicações de alta performance. Têm experiência com Segurança e Infraestrutura: Conhecimento sólido em protocolos de segurança (OAuth2, JWT), além de familiaridade com Docker e ambientes de deploy (AWS/Heroku/DigitalOcean). title: Back End Developer
description:
About EverUp We’re a UK startup making gift-card shopping rewarding. Our mobile app (React Native) and web (React) run on a serverless AWS backend. We’re hiring a Backend Cloud Engineer to evolve and maintain the APIs, databases, and services that power payments, wallet, rewards, and near-real-time features. The role You’ll work across our event-driven, serverless stack to maintain and evolve production systems. That means adding features, fixing bugs, improving performance and cost, tightening security, and raising reliability—while collaborating closely with Mobile/Web. What you’ll do Maintain and evolve AWS Lambda microservices behind Amazon API Gateway (HTTP/REST & WebSocket) and AWS IoT Core ;
implement authentication/authorization via Cognito User Pools (JWT) and Lambda authorizers for REST/HTTP. Maintain and optimize data models and access patterns in DynamoDB and MySQL (RDS);
handle indexes, migrations, and query performance. Maintain asynchronous workflows using SQS/SNS (idempotency, DLQs, retries) and keep observability healthy with CloudWatch metrics/logs and alarms. Maintain and improve our IaC (AWS SAM/CloudFormation), CI/CD pipelines, and environment promotions. Integrate and support third-party services used for payments, open banking, notifications, fraud/risk, analytics and support tooling. Troubleshoot production issues, drive RCAs, and implement preventive fixes and runbooks. Uphold security best practices (least-privilege IAM, secret management, input validation, auditability). Tech you’ll touch AWS Lambda, API Gateway (REST/WebSocket), Cognito, DynamoDB, RDS MySQL, SQS/SNS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, CloudFormation/SAM, EC2, ECS, plus fintech/comms integrations (Open Banking/PSP, Gift Cards, Analytics, Messaging, Support, and Risk assessment tools). Must-haves 8+ years building/maintaining production backends;
4+ years with AWS serverless (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB). Proficiency in JavaScript/Node.Js;
strong REST API fundamentals and event-driven patterns. Solid SQL/NoSQL skills (schema design, indexing, query tuning). Experience maintaining IaC (SAM/CloudFormation) and CI/CD (Code Pipeline). Security-first mindset and practical debugging/troubleshooting chops (OWASP). WebSocket/API Gateway connection management and real-time features. Payments/fintech and fraud/risk integrations. Observability practices (dashboards, tracing, log correlation) and SLOs. Elastic Beanstalk familiarity and data pipelines/warehousing exposure. How we work Remote-first within UK time zone, startup-paced, with high ownership. We value clean code, small safe changes, and excellent operability. Hiring process Intro call Technical deep-dive (systems design discussions focused on maintainability and evolution) Practical walkthrough (IaC/API/data-modeling maintenance scenario) Founder/lead chat & references Equal opportunity We’re an equal-opportunity employer and welcome every background and perspective. How to apply Send your CV, GitHub/portfolio, and a brief note describing a production backend you maintained/evolved and the reliability or cost improvements you delivered.

title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Role Overview Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration. Key Responsibilities Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation) Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes. Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes. Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations. Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools. Automation, Integration & AI Implementation Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.G., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript). Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks. Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software. IT Administration & Security Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365). Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access. Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security. Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl. Required Qualifications & Skills Technical Experience: 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration. Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment. Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures. High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.G., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting. Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows. Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols. Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies: Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity. Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving;
ability to identify theroot causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms. Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution;
capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions. Benefits & Compensation Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.
